# access.GrantMembershipInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Grants roles to a user at a node (core.member.update); one membership per user and node.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.GrantMembershipInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.member.update` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | yes | `none` | Node to grant at; must be in the path's organization. |  |
| `roles` | yes | `none` | Roles to grant; each must be within the caller's permissions (no escalation). |  |
| `userId` | yes | `personal` | Uid of the user to grant. |  |

_None._
